growth-deck.description: Riveted armored side gallery with luminous lancets, brass guardrails, capstan finials and diagonal mounting braces.
growth-deck.intendedMount: Outer side hardpoints, around local Y2.35; rotate or mirror for port and starboard.

growth-engine.description: Paired pressure engines with compression ribs, luminous aft exhaust ducts, copper-roofed pressure regulator and exposed feed pipes.
growth-engine.intendedMount: Aft hull around X-3.35,Y1.0; local base centered between both engines.

growth-tower.description: Narrow Gothic signal spire with four luminous lancets, a steep copper helm, golden braces and pearl finial.
growth-tower.intendedMount: Outer gallery or free aft corner; XZ footprint1.3 units.

growth-reactor.description: Luminous faceted core suspended inside a swept brass cage, with an orthogonal containment orbit and copper crown.

growth-battery.description: Open annular armored turret balcony with rotating brass bearing, angled frontal shields and mounting braces.
growth-battery.intendedMount: Stable hardpoint socket beneath the weapon; weapon mesh can recoil independently.

growth-crown.description: Open imperial citadel crown: four copper-helmed towers, stepped Hanseatic gables, luminous lancets and castellated parapets.
growth-crown.intendedMount: Around the upper mount near X-1.1,Y4.5; open center preserves the upper weapon.
